plan.title: AD lesional vs control skin DE + hallmark pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 AD-lesional vs 6 control skin, unpaired, single batch) go through sample structure QC first because sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median — per grounded rule R-0008 this sample is kept, inspected on PCA/distance heatmap and reported, not silently dropped. PyDESeq2 (Python, per user constraint) performs median-of-ratios normalization, a minimal count pre-filter, the Wald test with an explicit reference level (Control), and apeglm shrinkage of the log2 fold changes. Genes are called by BH-adjusted p-value < 0.05 with independent filtering, and the fold-change effect is reported alongside — never used alone to call significance. The full ranked gene list (Wald stat, per the disputed-rule choice stated here) is then tested with gseapy prerank GSEA against the local MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (50 sets) for pathway-level change, since AD is a well-studied inflammatory/barrier condition where individual-gene calls and coordinated pathway shifts both matter. A final report step consolidates DE gene tables, fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion), the low-depth-sample caveat, and the enrichment results with leading-edge genes and full reproducibility metadata.
